item.title: Psalm 12 — God’s Pure Word in a Corrupt World
item.description: In this episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave, Dave Jenkins walks through Psalm 12, a lament describing moral collapse and the purity of God’s flawless Word. This psalm reminds believers that even when truth seems rare and evil seems loud, God speaks, rises to defend the needy, and preserves His people through His Word.

item.title: Keeping God’s Word at the Center of the Home
item.description: Dave Jenkins explains how families can keep God’s Word at the center of daily life through simple, biblical rhythms rooted in Deuteronomy 6:6–7.

item.title: Why Christian Families Must Treasure the Local Church
item.description: Family life today is often busy and stretched thin. In this episode of Contending for the Word Q&A, Dave Jenkins explains from Hebrews 10:24–25 why Christian families must treasure the local church as God’s means of strengthening faith, shaping children, protecting souls, and anchoring believers in truth.

item.title: How Counterfeit Movements Gain Traction in the Church
item.description: In this episode of The Weekly Watch, part of the Contending for the Word podcast, Dave Jenkins examines how counterfeit movements gain traction inside the church and why biblical vigilance rooted in Scripture is essential for faithful discipleship.

item.title: Psalm 13 — Honest Lament and Confident Trust in God’s Steadfast Love
item.description: In this episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave, Dave Jenkins walks through Psalm 13 and shows how Scripture gives believers a pattern for bringing sorrow to God through honest lament, earnest prayer, and renewed trust in His steadfast love. David’s repeated cry of “How long, O Lord?” reminds us that lament is not unbelief—it is faith expressed in the darkness. item.title: Pursuing Purity in a Digital World
item.description: Temptation is no longer distant or occasional. In a digital world filled with constant access, private screens, and endless distractions, Christians face unique challenges in pursuing holiness. Anchored in Psalm 101:3, this episode shows that purity begins in the heart and is sustained through wise boundaries, godly habits, honest accountability, and delighting in Christ above all.
